title: Minimum Cost to Repair Edges to Traverse a Graph
summary: Every edge in an undirected graph starts damaged and has a repair cost. Choose a nonnegative threshold and repair all edges costing at most that threshold. Return the smallest threshold permitting a path from node zero to node n-1 using at most k edges, or -1 if impossible.
